Class Rating

java.lang.Object
book.Rating
public class Rating extends Object
This class represents a book rating, including various criteria scores and optional comments.
Version:
1.0.0 (30-06-2025)
Author:
Matteo Mantica and Leonardo Lambruschi

  • Constructor Details

    • Rating

      public Rating(String BookshelfName, String userid, String Book, int stile, int contenuto, int gradevolezza, int originalita, int edizione, int votofinale, String styleComment, String contentComment, String pleasantnessComment, String originalityComment, String editionComment)
      Constructs a new Rating object with detailed rating information and comments.
      Parameters:
      BookshelfName - The name of the bookshelf the book belongs to.
      userid - The ID of the user who provided the rating.
      Book - The title of the book being rated.
      stile - The rating for style (1-5).
      contenuto - The rating for content (1-5).
      gradevolezza - The rating for pleasantness (1-5).
      originalita - The rating for originality (1-5).
      edizione - The rating for edition (1-5).
      votofinale - The final calculated score (1-5).
      styleComment - Optional comment for style.
      contentComment - Optional comment for content.
      pleasantnessComment - Optional comment for pleasantness.
      originalityComment - Optional comment for originality.
      editionComment - Optional comment for edition.
